messages.同じ敵とマッチを重ねて決闘高潮を5まで積み、強化S3で振動-灼熱に変換して振動爆: A Burn and Tremor Identity that repeatedly clashes with the same enemy to build 5 The Duel Escalates, then uses enhanced S3 to convert Tremor to Tremor - Scorch and trigger repeated bursts. The resulting Maturing Textbook further strengthens the next cycle.
messages.決闘高潮: パッシブ「デュエロ・ディスペラート」により、基本スキルの終了時、メイ: **The Duel Escalates**: Through the passive Duello Disperato, at the end of a basic skill, inflicts 1 The Duel Escalates on the main target if it is alive (2 if he Clashed with it). Maximum 5, up to 3 per turn. At the start of a Clash with an enemy that has The Duel Escalates, he recovers SP equal to its value, up to 5 per turn. Defeating an enemy with The Duel Escalates grants 1 Maturing Textbook.
messages.完成されゆく教本: 基本スキルのダメージ量+(10+数値×5)%。最大3、1ター: **Maturing Textbook**: Basic skills deal +(10 + value×5)% damage. Maximum 3, up to 2 per turn.
messages.強化S3「セッチォナトゥラ・デル・チェルヴォ」: 対象の決闘高潮が5のとき、S3: **Enhanced S3 — Sezionatura di Cervo**: When the target has 5 The Duel Escalates, S3 Il Cacciatore turns into this, once per turn. All Coins are Unbreakable. Attack Weight increases by (Textbook − 1), up to 2. Coin Ⅳ performs Amplitude Conversion into Tremor - Scorch and triggers Tremor Burst 2/3 times. After the attack, it spends all of the target's The Duel Escalates and grants 1 Textbook (2 if the target was defeated).
messages.振動-灼熱: 振動爆発のたびに、(振動威力+火傷威力)÷2の憤怒ダメージを与え、: **Tremor - Scorch**: Each Tremor Burst deals Wrath damage equal to (Tremor Potency + Burn Potency) ÷ 2 and reduces Burn Count by 1. The regular S3 also converts into Tremor - Scorch with Coin Ⅲ and triggers Tremor Burst once. With Textbook or 3 or more The Duel Escalates on the target, it triggers 2 more times.
messages.バトルパッシブ「パレルモ剣術」(色欲×2・怠惰×2・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): 教: **Combat passive — Palermitan Style (2 Lust and 2 Sloth Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: Strengthens based on the combined Textbook and the target's The Duel Escalates: +1 Clash Power at 1, +1 Base Power at 2, Severed Tendon next turn at 3, +1 Final Power at 4, and +15% damage at 5. Also +3% damage dealt per point, up to 15%, and −3% damage taken per point, up to 15%.
messages.守備「剣先で測る」: マッチ可能な反撃。対象の決闘高潮1につきダメージ量+10%: **Defense skill — Measuring Blade Reach**: A clashable counter. +10%/20% damage per The Duel Escalates on the target, up to 50%/100%.
messages.狙う敵を決めてマッチを重ね、決闘高潮を積む。決闘高潮が5になったら強化S3で振動: Pick an enemy to target, keep Clashing with it, and stack The Duel Escalates. At 5, use the enhanced S3 to trigger Tremor - Scorch Tremor Bursts and gain Textbook. Then repeat the same steps to stack The Duel Escalates again. Once the passive's resources are gathered, S1 can be replaced with the Defense skill Measuring Blade Reach, which grows with The Duel Escalates. Paired with Rodion's The House of Spiders: The Thumb Nursefather, through Desperate Struggle, his basic skill hits trigger a La Spada di Palermo follow-up while Rodion has Eye of Precognition, once per turn. The Duel Escalates builds faster as a result, so use them as a set. He excels in Focused Encounters, where he can choose an enemy and keep hitting it.
